_about: Comment -> DM auto-reply for @hemanth_chakka. ANY comment on a post gets one DM carrying THAT post's own resource (posts -> resources), plus a short public reply. The resource text stays word for word; everything around it (greeting, a line reacting to the comment, the public reply) is written fresh each time by the writer model, with the text banks below as the fallback. Placeholders in the banks: {name} first name (only used when we have one), {thing} the resource name, {topic} the reel the person commented on.
_any_comment_since_note: Switch-over to any-comment mode (19 Nov, owner). Comments older than this are never touched, so nobody from before gets a late or second DM.
_delay_note: Each comment waits its own random 2-7 minutes before the reply, so replies don't land at a machine-like fixed time.
closing_line: Hope you will follow me for such more updates on time
_owner_note: 19 Nov, owner: 'Keep ours only, just that a safe card along with a message that says Hope you will follow me for such more updates on time'. closing_line is the owner's own words, verbatim, at the end of every DM.

writer._note: Writes the DM opener and the public reply for each comment. Claude (claude_model) is used when the repo has the ANTHROPIC_API_KEY secret (owner's paid key; about a cent per few hundred comments with Haiku). GitHub Models (github_models) answered only a bare 'OK' on 19 Nov 2026, so it is off. With no writer, the text banks below write everything, reacting to the kind of comment (react_by_type, public_by_type). Every writer answer is checked; a bad one falls back to the banks.

safety_card.name: family safety card
public_replies: Sent. If you don't see it, check message requests
On its way to your inbox
safety_card.dm:
🛡️ Family safety card
WhatsApp > Settings:
1. Privacy > Calls > Silence unknown callers ON
2. Privacy > Advanced > Protect IP address in calls ON
3. Account > Two-step verification > set a PIN
4. Family group > tap its name > Advanced chat privacy ON
Panic call asking for money, even in a voice you know? Ask your family code word. No word = hang up, call back on the saved number.
"Power cut tonight, call this officer" SMS = scam. Never install AnyDesk for anyone.
Money lost? Call 1930 right away.

chatgpt_codes.name: list of 10 ChatGPT codes
public_replies: Sent. Check message requests if you don't see it
Check DMs, the list is there
chatgpt_codes.dm:
10 ChatGPT "codes" that work (plain words, any AI):
1. Devil's advocate: [your idea]
2. Explain like I'm 10, with a daily-life example: [topic]
3. Quiz me on [topic], 5 questions, one at a time
4. Answer in 3 lines: [question]
5. Make this a table: [messy info]
6. Give me 3 really different options: [task]
7. What am I missing? List the risks: [plan]
8. Check this and explain each fix: [your text]
9. Rewrite this, simple and polite: [message]
10. Ask me questions first, then answer: [problem]
Save your favourites in Settings > Personalization > Custom instructions.

🎧 Read a long voice note in seconds (Android):
1. In WhatsApp, press and hold the voice note
2. Tap the 3 dots, then Share
3. Swipe across the share list and pick Gemini
4. Type: Help me summarise this audio recording in 5 points.
Free Gemini takes up to 10 minutes of audio, so most family voice notes fit. Free accounts have a daily limit on audio uploads.
Full steps: https://techwithhemanth.vercel.app/library/voice-note-gemini

pf_missed_call.name: PF balance steps
pf_missed_call.dm:
📞 PF balance with one missed call:
From the mobile linked to your UAN, call 99660 44425. It rings once and cuts by itself. EPFO then sends an SMS with your PF balance, last contribution and UAN. Free.
In Telugu: SMS EPFOHO <your UAN> TEL to 77382 99899 from the same number.
Works only if your UAN is active and your Aadhaar, PAN or bank account is linked to it.
EPFO never asks for an OTP or a fee for this. If someone does, it's a scam.

_posts_note: How a post finds its resource: 1) its shortcode (the part after /reel/ in its link), 2) the first 'match' entry whose words appear in the caption's first two lines (not counting a line that starts with 'Comment'), 3) the 'Comment XYZ' keyword in its caption. A post with none of these keeps its comments waiting (up to 6 days) and opens one GitHub issue; add its entry and push, and the waiting comments get answered on the next run.
